Tirana: house price index (Bank of Albania survey)

attribution: Bank of Albania (Banka e Shqipërisë), survey 'Tregu i pasurive të paluajtshme', house price (Fischer) index, time-series workbook 'Tabelat e vrojtimit', bankofalbania.org; (c) Bank of Albania, all rights reserved; credited.
basis: Bank of Albania Fischer house price index from its half-yearly survey of builders and estate agents (stratified median of reported sales), Tirana, 2013 = 100
name: Tirana
notes: Tirana: Bank of Albania Fischer house price index from its half-yearly survey of about 230 builders and estate agents (stratified median of the sale prices they report), 2013 = 100; quarterly 2014 Q1-Q3, half-yearly from 2015 H1, each half placed at its last quarter. Not hedonic, volatile with the mix of central-Tirana sales. The 2025 H2 Tirana cell of the Bank's workbook repeats the national value (the report text gives Tirana nearly unchanged on the half-year) and is left out.
